question.text: You mention designing event pipelines on Apache Kafka for settlement batches. Walk me through your own role in that work and the result.

strongSignals: Names concrete design choices and why
weakSignals: Describes only team work without own role

competencies.name: Technical skill
competencies.description: Depth and accuracy of technical knowledge

anchors.1: Incorrect or no relevant technical content
anchors.2: Recognises terms but explanation is vague or partly incorrect
anchors.3: Correct explanation of core concepts with a basic example
anchors.4: Correct, specific explanation with trade-offs or real usage
anchors.5: Deep, precise explanation covering edge cases, alternatives and when not to use it

anchors.2: Generic example without own role or detail
anchors.3: Concrete example with own role described
anchors.4: Specific example with own decisions, actions and results
anchors.5: Detailed example with ownership, measurable outcome and lessons learned
